objective: Optimizer-native state-conditioned learning with no covariance matrices, covariance sketches, Fisher state, or Kalman updates. Ordinary model weights and linear-sized moment/history buffers only.
motivation: Scalar reliability gates and short-horizon meta-descent were mostly null in family measurements. Adam averages gradients evaluated at changing weights: larger averaging horizons reduce observation noise but introduce model-drift bias. Test whether same-example predictive transport removes that tradeoff.

derivation.gradient: g_t=(f(theta_t,x_t)-y_t) J(theta_t,x_t), with J exact output Jacobian.
derivation.full_difference: g_t-g_previous_on_current_example = (f_t-f_previous)J_t + (f_previous-y_t)(J_t-J_previous). Both evaluations use the same current x_t,y_t.
derivation.predictive_difference: C_t=(f_t-f_previous)J_t omits the residual-times-Jacobian-change term. It is independent of the current label, but biased relative to full nonlinear gradient transport.
derivation.noise: In a linear model J_t=J_previous, shared observation noise cancels exactly in the difference. Nonlinear full difference retains -epsilon_t*(J_t-J_previous). This is not a noise-cancellation guarantee for all nonlinear gradients.
derivation.moment: m_t=beta*m_(t-1)+(1-beta)*g_t + beta*(1-beta^(t-1))*C_t. Transport the mass actually present in the biased historical moment, not a full unit mass during startup. With exact deterministic gradient changes, m_t=(1-beta^t)*g_t.
derivation.preconditioner: All arms use ordinary bias-corrected Adam v on RAW g_t squared, beta2=.999, eps1e-8. Corrected first moment supplies direction. No covariance and no corrected-gradient second-moment confound.
derivation.state_proxy: q_row=||J_t,row||^2/(||J_t,row||^2+||J_t,row-J_previous,row||^2), q=1 if both norms vanish. It attenuates predictive transport according to current-state Jacobian stability; it is not calibrated statistical uncertainty or a learned noise predictor.

arms.adam: Ordinary Adam, independently jointly LR/beta tuned.
arms.uncertainty: Prediction-change transport times current state per-incoming-row q.
arms.shared: Same q values averaged within each layer, erasing within-layer neuron attachment.
arms.history: Previous per-row EMA(q), rate .001, updated after its current use; erases current-state attachment while retaining historical unit differences.

experiments.next: Full stationary comparison to distinguish drift correction from noise/regime weighting; extend any winning LR/beta bracket before making a superiority claim. No new seeds.

selection.pre_outcome_amendment: Before any contract/training job started, expanded both axes to60configs perarm to test long-horizon transport and bracket ordinaryAdam. Original21config job5705cancelledbeforestart; replacement jobs5707stationary/5708stress. No result-driven selection or model change.
selection.boundary_extension: Completed jobs5744/5745 selected stress Adam beta=.5, at its lower boundary. Extend all six families in both tasks with beta=0,.1,.3 (90 joint candidates per family), retaining every original candidate. Selection remains validation-only. Beta0 is the physical lower bound; this extension rule was specified before outcomes.
selection.criterion: Each family independently minimizes duration-weighted sustained clean-validation error across the joint grid. Persist selection before any untouched clean-test scoring. Report LR and beta boundaries separately.
selection.invalid_candidates: A candidate with nonfinite validation or optimizer state at any checkpoint is explicitly disqualified and retained as failed evidence. Do not discard merely poor finite candidates, rescue failures, or choose from test outcomes. Failure must stay isolated from other batched configs.
selection.success: Primary must beat jointly tuned Adam, predictive q=1, layer-shared q, and past-only q to credit current per-neuron state. A different transport arm beating Adam supports gradient transport, not a post-hoc primary replacement.

execution.precision: Reference task generation. CUDA FP32 weights/moments, FP64 forward/Jacobian teaching signals in every arm. Ill-conditioned FP32 Jacobian differences failed transition parity near zero sensitivity; precision changed before any successful experiment. Compiled transitions and separately captured history/weight commits; no CPU fallback.
execution.autocull: No performance cull during fixed65536-observation diagnostic streams because switch/recovery and sustained selection require the complete horizon. Invalid candidates remain visibly failed, with no retries.

verification: Independent autograd and optimizer recurrence, startup and beta0 identity, analytic moment-mass transport, linear shared-noise cancellation, causal current-label-independent predictive correction/q, prior-only history use, per-config isolation, complete capture restoration and exact stream counts.
limits: One paired task seed; no covariance competitor executed. Historical full-EKF scores may be context, never silently called a matched new run. Existing STORM/MARS-like gradient-transport ideas are precedents, not a claimed invention. No global-optimality, PPO or calibrated-uncertainty claim. Two network evaluations for transport are not compute-matched to one for Adam.
